description: Site des zones de prévention des captages de Wallonie approuvées par arrêté ministériel is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SPW ARNE. L’application cartographique Protection des eaux souterraines en Wallonie permet de consulter les zones de prévention arrêtées et à l’enquête. A noter que ces données cartographiques ne sont mises à jour que deux à trois fois par an. Les plans de détails sont consultables à l’administration. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are eau. The portal shows 485 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
